about: Files that published markdown links to but the public repo does not carry: the walkthrough videos, too big for every clone's history. scripts/release/publish-public.mjs renames each to <stem>-<sha256:10>.<ext>, copies it into a clone of `repo` (--media-to) and re-points every link at `urlBase`/<name>. A re-recording is a new name, so older releases keep their links. {org} is BRAND.githubOrg. urlBase is GitHub Pages on that repo; https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/{org}/media@main serves the same files without Pages.
